stemBlocks:
A drawbridge system consists of a uniform ramp, of weight $W$, that is smoothly hinged at its lower end. The upper end is connected by a light, inextensible cable to a winch that is fixed to the wall in the position shown in the diagram.
The ramp is lowered slowly, at constant speed, from its closed (vertical) position ($\theta = 0^\circ$) to its open (horizontal) position ($\theta = 90^\circ$).
What is the maximum tension in the cable during this process?

assets.alt: A diagram showing a drawbridge system. A ramp is hinged at its lower end. A cable connects the upper end of the ramp to a winch fixed on a wall. The angle between the ramp and the vertical wall is labeled $\theta$. The ramp is shown in an intermediate position, with dashed lines indicating its vertical (closed) and horizontal (open) positions.
